purpose_KO: 기존 공개 팔레트 영상의 세 후보 reference가 실제 코너·부분선 영상 단서를 가리키는지 독립적으로 확인합니다. 더 좋은 pixel mask가 곧 코너 가시성 정답이라는 가정을 반복하지 않고, 다음 감독 목표를 실제 공개 자료에 연결하기 위한 단계입니다.
scope: Existing V67/V69 R2B3 AI reference proposals and already local public R2B frames only. V72 public_pallet_initializer saved source q/input metadata may be read to establish initial-query lineage. No current223 RGB/annotation/features/scores or model weights.
reviewers: Two separate AI reviewers freeze policies before raw public RGB reads and inspect independently. Share only paths/coordinates/metadata until both reports sealed; do not share judgments in advance.
review_fields: proposed reference pixel and visible cue
saved initializer query availability and association evidence
source_label_tier: AI-reviewed weak source evidence only, even if reviewers agree. Human-confirmed semantic gold remains0. A random mask-positive pixel or an AI anchor ID is not a canonical native8 corner.
invariants: Preserve all old proposals/data and fixed coordinate candidates
Do not invent native8 IDs or snap references to physical mesh
Do not use current223 to choose cue definitions/points/crops
Do not silently move a proposed point to make it visibly correct; record correction proposals separately
Do not split related R2B clips/sensors as independent capture families without evidence
next_gate: After the actual source evidence review, root will separately decide whether a narrowly named observed-cue controlled proxy can be admitted. This review itself does not admit semantic D/E/S labels or authorize a fit.
